text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the social media posts and 
trend data, 
it appears that a great many people are 
enjoying it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right! Um, by the way... 
What is this tag sitting at number one on 
the trends?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan-Love-Myoooooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's the one. 
As expected, you've already checked it 
out♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*. ...No, it is not! 
This is Maru-chan's tag!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, you're right. 
Every single post includes a photo of 
Maruchan-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, and what's more, all of them have 
cute heart-and-love-style filters added to 
them. So adorable♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Did the fans create this tag for you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, it is what Maru-chan added... 
when quoting a fan's post.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! You're creating some wonderful 
"synergy" there♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Interaction...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! Even in livestreams, it's such 
an important element... 
Two-way communication is what makes it so 
thrilling, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You react to something, and they react 
back... 
Everyone was having a blast because they 
were happy to connect with you like that, 
don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"—I see. 
So that is what was happening..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the selfie challenge video I 
made—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It was a self-disclosure strategy chosen 
to 'showcase individuality.' 
However, the joyful responses from the 
viewers far exceeded my expectations."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"'Ikuno's funnier than I thought,' 'She's 
surprisingly into it,' 
'I'm so glad to see this side of her,' 
'I've always wanted to know more about 
her'..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The fans truly wanted to get to know me. 
And it made them happy to learn more."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That made me so very happy as well...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The fans' feelings and my actions 
unintentionally aligned. 
I believe that the joy felt in that 
moment... was the joy of mutual 
interaction."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And so... everyone was getting so 
excited... 
making the Makachyawa-Love Myon-Myon..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"—The feelings they want to send to 
Chan... 
The feelings Chan wants to send back... 
That is mutual interaction..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided! 
On the contents of our next mini-stream!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We will realize a mutual interaction that 
will bring joy to our fans. 
The plan from here on—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Um, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I would like to consult you all. 
About the plan for the stream..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A thank-you...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. For the fans' feelings. For the 
banner that became a tailwind at my 
back... 
I wish to give something back in return."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Within our project this time, I would like 
to ask for a little bit of time to do so.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really know the specifics yet... 
but maybe a stream where we can properly 
say thank you? 
I thought it'd be nice if we could do 
something like that. What do you guys 
think?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu, that works out perfectly! 
Hey, Chan. Isn't this...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...! Giving something back for what we 
received from our fans... 
That is mutual interaction."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. It's simple, but I'm sure 
everyone's gonna love it♪"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Zephyr-san!! Thank you so much! 
Let's definitely—let's do a thank-you 
project!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—To summarize, we are completely changing 
the plan for Valentine's Day itself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The new project will be collecting 
requests from fans and answering them... 
A 'Fan Meeting'!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Since this is different from the 'making 
a cake' plan we announced before, and we 
need to put out a call for requests—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Let's just use our next scheduled 
mini-stream to make the announcement!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. In that case, would you give me 
some time during that announcement 
stream?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"There is something I wish to give to the 
fans. 
As a token of my gratitude for everything 
I have received so far... to give back."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"! 
Everything you have received...—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa, it's all Machan!! How many 
thousands of photos are in here?! 
Paddock, races... even photobombs from 
random TV broadcasts...?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I feel a tremendous hot breeze...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Um... If that is so, please let me join 
you. 
Chan wants to deliver something too... I 
have feelings I want to return—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"........................♪ 
...May a gentle breeze... blow into 
everyone's hearts—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"—Mission complete. Printouts are ready to 
go. 
All that's left is to match the design..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? From Zephyr-san... Woah! This is 
amazing. 
Maru-Zeph are fully prepared!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu, I wonder if they'll like it—
